title: A possible generating algorithm of the Voynich manuscript
summary: The authors use networks of similarly spelled EVA tokens to motivate a self-citation algorithm. It generates new tokens by copying and modifying strings already produced. The open link is the companion release cited in the 2020 paper and contains the implementation, graphs and generated text.
established: The authors set the parameters and length of their generated sample to correspond to the Recipes section and report roughly 10,000 tokens. Figures 6 and 7 compare the rank-frequency curve and growth in vocabulary with manuscript data and report both Zipf patterns.

The generated sample also shows an approximately binomial token-length distribution and correlations in the bit-level random-walk analysis. These comparisons concern the generated Recipes-style sample.
